name: Tri Nguyen Minh
title: Architect & Design Technologist
tagline: Exploring the evolving intersection of architectural craft, computational geometry, and creative engineering.
bioParagraphs: I am an Architect and Computational Design Technologist based in Vietnam. My practice merges rigorous spatial problem-solving with cutting-edge digital tooling, generative algorithms, and frontend engineering.

Over the past 8+ years, I have collaborated with leading architectural studios across Asia on high-rise residential towers, boutique hospitality resorts, cultural centers, and bespoke computational workflows.
Beyond traditional practice, I actively develop open-source spatial algorithms, WebGL design viewers, and BIM automation utilities through Tri-Labs.
